chapterInfo.content:
18
Bildad kasa sɛ abɔnefoɔ bɛsɛe
1Ɛnna Suhini Bildad buaa sɛ:
2Mobɛkɔ nsɛnkeka so akɔsi da bɛn?
Monnwene ho, na ɛno akyiri no, yɛakasa.
3 # Hiob 17.4, 10 Adɛn na wɔbu yɛn sɛ anantwie,
na yɛyɛ mo ani so sɛ tibɔnkɔso anaa?
4Wo a wotete wo ho w’abufuo mu.
Wo nti na wɔbɛgya asase,
na wɔatu ɔbotan afiri ne sibea anaa?
5 # Hiob 18.18; 21.17; Dwom 73.18-20; Mmb 13.9; 24.20 Nanso ɔbɔnefoɔ kanea bɛdum,
na ne gyaframa renhyerɛn.
6Hann bɛduru sum, ne ntomadan mu,
na ne kanea adum wɔ ne so;
7n’ahoɔden anammɔn ano bɛmoa,
na n’agyinatuo ahwe no ase.
8Na ɔno ara ne nan bɛka no ato atena mu,
na wanante mfidie so.
9Nsɛmma bɛsɔ ne nantin,
na nkyehoma akyekyere no.
10Wɔde kantankoraa bɛhunta fam ama no,
na wɔasum no fidie ɔkwan so.
11Ehu bɛkuta no mmaa nyinaa ahyia,
na ati no n’anammɔn mu.
12Ɛkɔm bɛsɛe n’ahoɔden,
na mmusuo rebɛma no asunti.
13Ɛbɛdi ne honam akwaa,
aane, owuo abakan bɛdi n’akwaa.
14Wɔbɛtu n’anidasoɔ afiri ne ntomadan mu,
na wɔde no akɔ ahudeɛ mu hene no nkyɛn.
15Deɛ ɛnyɛ ne dea bɛtena ne ntomadan mu,
wɔbɛbɔ sɔfe apete ne tenabea.
16Ne nhini bɛwuwu wɔ aseɛ,
na ne mman adwinnwan wɔ soro.
17 # Mmb 10.7 Ne nkaeɛ bɛsɛe afiri asase so,
na ɔrennya din asase ani.
18Wɔbɛsum no afiri hann mu akɔ sum mu,
na wɔapam no afiri wiase.
19Ɔrennya mma anaa mmanana ne man mu,
na aseni biara renka n’atenaeɛ.
20Ne da bɛyɛ wɔn a wɔwɔ atɔeɛ ahodwiri,
sɛdeɛ ehu kutaa wɔn a wɔwɔ apueeɛ no.
21Ampa ara sɛdeɛ amumuyɛfoɔ tenabea teɛ ne no,
ne deɛ ɔnnim Onyankopɔn no nso kyɛfa nie.

pageProps.chapterText:
Ɛnna Suhini Bildad buaa sɛ:
Mobɛkɔ nsɛnkeka so akɔsi da bɛn?
Monnwene ho, na ɛno akyiri no, yɛakasa.
Adɛn na wɔbu yɛn sɛ anantwie,
na yɛyɛ mo ani so sɛ tibɔnkɔso anaa?
Wo a wotete wo ho w’abufuo mu.
Wo nti na wɔbɛgya asase,
na wɔatu ɔbotan afiri ne sibea anaa?

Nanso ɔbɔnefoɔ kanea bɛdum,
na ne gyaframa renhyerɛn.
Hann bɛduru sum, ne ntomadan mu,
na ne kanea adum wɔ ne so;
n’ahoɔden anammɔn ano bɛmoa,
na n’agyinatuo ahwe no ase.
Na ɔno ara ne nan bɛka no ato atena mu,
na wanante mfidie so.
Nsɛmma bɛsɔ ne nantin,
na nkyehoma akyekyere no.
Wɔde kantankoraa bɛhunta fam ama no,
na wɔasum no fidie ɔkwan so.
Ehu bɛkuta no mmaa nyinaa ahyia,
na ati no n’anammɔn mu.
Ɛkɔm bɛsɛe n’ahoɔden,
na mmusuo rebɛma no asunti.
Ɛbɛdi ne honam akwaa,
aane, owuo abakan bɛdi n’akwaa.
Wɔbɛtu n’anidasoɔ afiri ne ntomadan mu,
na wɔde no akɔ ahudeɛ mu hene no nkyɛn.
Deɛ ɛnyɛ ne dea bɛtena ne ntomadan mu,
wɔbɛbɔ sɔfe apete ne tenabea.
Ne nhini bɛwuwu wɔ aseɛ,
na ne mman adwinnwan wɔ soro.
Ne nkaeɛ bɛsɛe afiri asase so,
na ɔrennya din asase ani.
Wɔbɛsum no afiri hann mu akɔ sum mu,
na wɔapam no afiri wiase.
Ɔrennya mma anaa mmanana ne man mu,
na aseni biara renka n’atenaeɛ.
Ne da bɛyɛ wɔn a wɔwɔ atɔeɛ ahodwiri,
sɛdeɛ ehu kutaa wɔn a wɔwɔ apueeɛ no.
Ampa ara sɛdeɛ amumuyɛfoɔ tenabea teɛ ne no,
ne deɛ ɔnnim Onyankopɔn no nso kyɛfa nie.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
